edge.title: Wrap AdamW+Muon in EMA-Nesterov lookahead (γ=0.99, β=0.6·lr ratio)
edge.summary: #12's optimizers (aux AdamW + Muon, hparams unchanged) are wrapped by EMA_Nesterov over all parameters. The wrapper keeps buf, an EMA (γ=0.99) of each step's total parameter displacement; before each forward/backward it shifts the weights by β·buf with β = 0.6·lr/initial_lr during steps 500–2399, computes gradients there, and lets the inner optimizers step from the shifted point, so the shift is never undone. This acts like an extra long-horizon momentum on the combined update, amplifying its persistent component by up to 1/(1−β) = 2.5x at peak LR, and saves 200 steps (3325 → 3125 claimed, 3150 scheduled).

changes.label: EMA-Nesterov wrapper
changes.detail: optimizers = [EMA_Nesterov(all params, [optimizer1, optimizer2], ...)]. Its step() runs the inner AdamW and Muon steps, then accum_lookahead: buf.lerp_(p − prev_params, 1 − 0.99) and prev_params ← p, so buf is an EMA of the full per-step displacement (including the previous shift).

changes.label: Lookahead shift before fwd/bwd
changes.detail: optimizers[0].nesterov_step() runs before the micro-batch loop; when prefill_steps < it+1 and it < rest_steps, lookahead_step adds lookahead_stepsize·lr_ratio·buf to every param, so gradients and the inner step are taken at the shifted point.

changes.label: β schedule and active window
changes.detail: lookahead_stepsize=0.6 times get_lr_lambda() = lr/initial_lr of the first aux group (the shared WSD factor, read before set_hparams, one step stale); prefill_steps=500 and rest_steps=train_steps−750=2400, so shifts happen at steps 500–2399 while buf accumulates from step 0.

changes.label: Steps 3350/3325 → 3150/3125
changes.detail: train_steps=3150 with the result read at 3125 (the 25-step early stop is kept).

changes.label: Wrapper plumbing
changes.detail: set_hparams iterates optimizers[0].inner_optimizer, the param-coverage assert moves after wrapping, blank-line edits.

edge.parent_check: Consistent (declared 'Setup from #12'): Muon lr 0.035 / wd 0.025, aux AdamW settings, init and 0.7 cooldown are unchanged from #12.
edge.noise: Blank lines, missing trailing newline, and the set_hparams/assert plumbing needed for the wrapper.

mechanisms.name: EMA-Nesterov lookahead wrapper
mechanisms.explain: The wrapper tracks buf = EMA_0.99 of each parameter's displacement x_{t+1} − x_t (inner optimizer step plus the previous shift); inside the active window it moves the weights to y = x + β_t·buf with β_t = 0.6·lr_t/lr_max before computing gradients, Nesterov-style. The inner optimizers update from y and the result becomes the next x, so shifts accumulate. buf then behaves like a heavy-ball momentum with effective decay γ + (1−γ)β ≈ 0.996 that extrapolates the smooth trajectory and amplifies its persistent component by up to 1/(1−β).

caveats: The 1/(1−β) amplification is a steady-state estimate for a constant inner update, not measured. Shifts stop for the last 750 scheduled steps (it < 2400) and β also follows the LR cooldown. Validation runs before nesterov_step, i.e. on x_t without the next shift. Run on 8×A100; n=20, mean 3.2786 at 3125.
